title: ticket.created.v1 payload
description: Payload of the ticket.created.v1 event, emitted by ticket-service when an appeal is registered (manual entry in EP-1; from mail later). Personal data is minimized: the applicant's national identifier appears only in masked form (identifierMasked); the full identifier is never placed in events or logs (ADR-006, docs/06, Q-D3).

registrationNumber.description: Business registration number of the appeal (for example, AP-2026-000001).

receivedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the appeal was received.

registeredAt.description: UTC timestamp when the appeal was registered.

subject.description: Short subject line of the appeal.

applicant.description: The consumer party in privacy-minimized form. No full national identifier is included.

applicantType.description: Role of the party (the consumer for a created ticket).

identifierType.description: Kind of national identifier, if known.

identifierMasked.description: Masked national identifier (only the last digits are shown), or null.

hasRepresentative.description: Whether a representative party is attached to the ticket.
